title: Brenda G NDE 2371
content: I had agreed to go out on a blind date with my girlfriend and her boy friend. The evening started out at a drive-in and my friend and the guys started drinking and doing drugs. I had one beer because I didn't go in for that kind of stuff. My girlfriend and her boyfriend eventually passed out in the back seat. When we left the drive-in, I was so glad to be going home because I had spent most of the night fending this guy off. I didn't notice right away that he wasn't going the right way. I said to him, you're going the wrong way. He said I have to make a stop first. Next thing I know he stops and all around us is just woods. He got out of the car, came around to my side, and said get out. I said why then he just grabbed my arm and pulled me out. I yelled for my friend but she was passed out and didn't respond. He dragged me into the woods I don't know how far. I remember crying and asking him to let me go. He must have hit me and knocked me out because this is where my experience began. It felt like I walked through a door of some kind. It was all dark but not a scary dark. I didn't feel fear; I felt calm and started to wonder where I was. All of a sudden, there was a very bright light. As I turned toward the light, the things that happened next happened really fast. This voice came out of the light and at the same time, I slammed back in my body. I felt my lips move. The voice in the light said I'll quit crying. At that moment I became aware that he was sitting on top of me, he had been punching me in the face. With what I said, he immediately stopped and let me get up. Something in my head kept telling me to get to the car. I didn't know where the car was. It was as if something was directing me as I got to my feet and started moving. I saw two people standing there but they had long robes on and it was a woman and man. The only thing I thought when I saw them was 'who are they' and 'how strange' Then that voice in my head said 'Get to the car.' Somehow, I don't know how I did it, but I made it to the car, and finally woke my friend. I am glad to say I survived but I know that I wouldn't have if not for the help I received. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: 1970 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes attempted rape Life threatening event, but not clinical death How do you consider the content of your experience? Mixed Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I lost awareness of my body How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Normal consciousness and alertness At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? From the time I stepped into the darkness. Were your thoughts speeded up? Incredibly fast Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening all at once Were your senses more vivid than usual? Incredibly more so Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. People I saw I somehow know they were not human form, plus the light, I have never seen such a light before. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Neither Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Uncertain I felt like stepped through something. Did you see any beings in your experience? Neither Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Yes The man and woman that were standing there watching me somehow I knew they were there for me. Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes It started very bright and was a distance away and than it stared coming closer and the brightness intensified. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Unfamiliar, strange place What emotions did you feel during the experience? Calm, peaceful. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Relief or calmness Did you have a feeling of joy? Neither Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? Neither Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe Did scenes from your past come back to you? Neither Did scenes from the future come to you? Neither Did you come to a border or point of no return? Neither God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Moderate Lutheran Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Moderate Lutheran Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? Definite being, or voice clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see deceased or religious spirits? Neither Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes More appreciative of others and how fragile life can be. After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes I shared it with a girlfriend about twenty years later. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real I just know because I watched it as it was happening. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real The same reason I know that someone, be it God or whatever, intervened or I would not be here today. Because I didn't mention in my story but I was beat up really bad I passed out twice before I got home. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Felt like she "walked through a door of some kind" / "stepped through something."

arrival.other_being_detail: A voice came out of the light; later she saw two people (a woman and a man) in long robes and believed they were "there for me."

environment.environment_other_detail: Darkness "but not a scary dark"; then a very bright light that came closer and intensified; described as an unfamiliar/strange place.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Attempted rape with physical assault; she reports being hit/knocked out and punched in the face.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Also reports seeing two robed figures (woman and man) after returning to bodily awareness, and an inner directing voice: "Get to the car."
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Transition through a door/darkness, bright light and voice, then an abrupt return to the body; guidance/figures perceived during escape afterward.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: She describes the voice coming out of the light "and at the same time" she "slammed back" into her body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: The spoken phrase attributed to the voice in the light: "I'll quit crying," which immediately caused the attacker to stop; two robed figures (woman and man) perceived as present "for me" during escape.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "It felt like I walked through a door of some kind."; "It was all dark but not a scary dark."; "All of a sudden, there was a very bright light."; "This voice came out of the light and at the same time, I slammed back in my body."; "The voice in the light said I'll quit crying."; "Get to the car."
